blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Explicit inherited: the verified stcUSD wrapper imposes no direct holder restriction, and its material freeze exposure routes through its ERC-4626 claim on the named upstream cusd-cap, whose verified Vault exposes governance-controlled protocol- and asset-level pause. The wrapper's bounded UUPS upgrade path (external AccessControl, one-day TimelockController, 3-of-5 governance Safe) can introduce a future holder control but none is deployed.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Reviewed 2026-07-30. At Ethereum block 25570002 (0x1875cd2), EIP-1967 implementation slots still resolved the stcUSD proxy 0x88887be419578051ff9f4eb6c858a951921d8888 to StakedCap 0x42c0e0ef7c2f35de073f4d6f9c0e4483429c3d31 and the cUSD proxy 0xcccc62962d17b8914c62d74ffb843d73b2a3cccc to CapToken 0xa76645e15c267b876999bf7689e0b2c1ee29bfe6 (eth_getStorageAt on the EIP-1967 implementation slot via PublicNode). The Sourcify exact-match StakedCap source tree (40 files, re-opened 2026-07-30) contains standard ERC-4626/ERC-20 transfer paths and no pause, blacklist, freeze, seize, or address-lock function. The freeze authority is the named upstream: the official cap-contracts Vault.sol inherited by CapToken exposes governance-gated pauseProtocol() and pauseAsset() with whenNotPaused transfer and vault paths (re-opened 2026-07-30), matching the separately reviewed cusd-cap direct system-wide pause verdict (reviewedAt 2026-07-14). stcUSD's freeze exposure is therefore inherited from cusd-cap through its ERC-4626 asset claim. The wrapper's own bounded UUPS upgrade path (external AccessControl, one-day TimelockController 0xd8236031d8279d82e615af2bfab5fc0127a329ab, 3-of-5 governance Safe, verified at block 25531350) can introduce a future holder control but none is deployed. Cap's terms and reserve dashboard document no additional deployed holder-control mechanism.
